counterfactual_missing_items: No disconfirming raw evidence; BRAF V600E negativity is compatible despite not being definitive for Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
decisive_items: Biopsies from the nail bed lesion and scalp papules revealed a diffuse infiltrate in the upper dermis of medium-to-large mononuclear cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and reniform nuclei admixed with inflammatory cells.
positivity for CD1a and S100 protein
response.rationale: C1 preserves the core diagnostic identity of R2 and adds the raw supported anatomical/distribution detail of nail bed and scalp involvement. R2 has the same histiologic and immunophenotypic foundation but lacks the composite spatial specification.
